# meca-limpia-agua (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F9, Templo del Agua), A: both ADULT at the entrance; room 02 cleared (Bool and counter key); Dark Link's room shut behind the one who went in never reaches B.
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test
# command) on orm/test8 (the `warp ... adult|child`, LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS). Generated by
# tools/harness/meca_adulto.py: change the table there, not this file. Positions from the Banc, not walked yet:
# a 'test place ...: failed' or a 'goto timed out' is the scenario's gap, not the code's.
# Mutant: the same run without LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS turns the 'never' lines of the adult list red.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 15-agua
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt
#! timeout 236
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Adult
#! expect A coop: test flag WaterTemple_Room02_Cleared \(0xdee97c7c\) = 1: queued within limpia..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0xdee97c7c \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within limpia..end
#! expect A coop: test key 0x59d5867377cce7ae = 1: queued within contador..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: key64 0x59d5867377cce7ae \(record \d+\) 0 -> 1 within contador..end
#! expect A coop: test flag WaterTemple_DarkLinkRoom_Locked \(0x5eb654bd\) = 1: queued within encierra..end
#! never B coop: flags debug: bool 0x5eb654bd 
#! expect A coop: test flag WaterTemple_Room20_EnterTheRoom \(0xd910e1e8\) = 1: queued within sensor..end
#! never B coop: flags debug: bool 0xd910e1e8 
mark start
warp WaterTemple WaterTemple_FromLakeHylia adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
wait 600                # the other game lands too: puppets made
mark limpia
flag WaterTemple_Room02_Cleared 1
wait 300
mark contador
key 0x59d5867377cce7ae 1   # Obj_EnemyCounter_A_01
wait 300
mark encierra
flag WaterTemple_DarkLinkRoom_Locked 1   # a player's own: never shared
wait 300
mark sensor
flag WaterTemple_Room20_EnterTheRoom 1   # a player's own: never shared
wait 300
mark tarde
wait 600
wait 300
mark end
